---- MODULE ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisa ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_hybrid_reliable_broadcast_cisaDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
\* ------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Helper definitions
\* ------------------------------------------------------------------

TypeOKA ==
  /\ accept \in [Node -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ sentMsg \in [Node -> [Node -> BOOLEAN]]
  /\ rcvMsg \in [Node -> [Node -> BOOLEAN]]

NoObInitA == \A m \in Node : Obedient(m) => m \notin RcvInit

SafeCoreA ==
  /\ \A s, d \in Node : (Obedient(d) /\ rcvMsg[s][d]) => sentMsg[s][d]
  /\ \A s, d \in Node : Obedient(s) => ~sentMsg[s][d]
  /\ \A n \in Node : Obedient(n) => ~accept[n]

SafeInvA == TypeOKA /\ (NoObInitA => SafeCoreA)

\* ------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Quorum facts
\* ------------------------------------------------------------------

LEMMA NoQuorumsL ==
  ASSUME NEW n \in Node, NEW rm,
         \A src \in Node : Obedient(src) => ~rm[src][n]
  PROVE  /\ ~HasAQuorumRcv(n, rm)
         /\ ~HasBQuorumRcv(n, rm)
<1>1. ~HasAQuorumRcv(n, rm)
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW a \in QuorumA,
                      \A src \in Node : InA(src, a) => rm[src][n]
               PROVE  FALSE
    BY DEF HasAQuorumRcv
  <2>1. PICK m \in Node : InA(m, a) /\ Obedient(m)
    BY QuorumAssumption
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1
<1>2. ~HasBQuorumRcv(n, rm)
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW b \in QuorumB,
                      \A src \in Node : InB(src, b) => rm[src][n]
               PROVE  FALSE
    BY DEF HasBQuorumRcv
  <2>1. PICK a \in QuorumA : \A z \in Node : InA(z, a) => (InB(z, b) /\ Symmetric(z))
    BY QuorumAssumption
  <2>2. PICK m \in Node : InA(m, a) /\ Obedient(m)
    BY QuorumAssumption
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2

\* ------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Type invariant
\* ------------------------------------------------------------------

LEMMA TypeNextL == ASSUME TypeOKA, [Next]_vars PROVE TypeOKA'
<1> USE TypeAssumption DEF TypeOKA
<1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
  BY <1>1 DEF vars
<1>2. CASE \E n \in Node : ReceiveInit(n)
  BY <1>2 DEF ReceiveInit, SendAllFrom
<1>3. CASE \E n, s \in Node : ReceiveMsg(n, s)
  BY <1>3 DEF ReceiveMsg, SendAllFrom
<1>4. CASE \E n, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgC(n, s)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgC(n, s)
    BY <1>4
  <2>2. PICK send \in BOOLEAN :
          LET newRcv == [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![s][n] = TRUE] IN
            /\ rcvMsg' = newRcv
            /\ accept' = IF HasBQuorumRcv(n, newRcv)
                           THEN [accept EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE] ELSE accept
            /\ sentMsg' = IF HasAQuorumRcv(n, newRcv) /\ send
                            THEN SendAllFrom(sentMsg, n) ELSE sentMsg
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveMsgC
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>2 DEF SendAllFrom
<1>5. CASE \E n \in Node : ReceiveInitI(n)
  BY <1>5 DEF ReceiveInitI
<1>6. CASE \E n, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgI(n, s)
  BY <1>6 DEF ReceiveMsgI
<1>7. CASE \E n \in Node : FaultySendS(n)
  BY <1>7 DEF FaultySendS, SendAllFrom
<1>8. CASE \E n \in Node : FaultyStateSA(n)
  BY <1>8 DEF FaultyStateSA, SetReceiveColumn
<1>9. CASE \E n \in Node : FaultySendA(n)
  BY <1>9 DEF FaultySendA
<1>10. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8, <1>9 DEF Next


\* ------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Core safety invariant step
\* ------------------------------------------------------------------

LEMMA ObedNoQL ==
  ASSUME TypeOKA, SafeCoreA, NEW n \in Node, Obedient(n), NEW s \in Node, sentMsg[s][n]
  PROVE  LET newRcv == [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![s][n] = TRUE] IN
           /\ ~HasAQuorumRcv(n, newRcv)
           /\ ~HasBQuorumRcv(n, newRcv)
           /\ \A src \in Node : newRcv[src][n] => sentMsg[src][n]
<1> DEFINE newRcv == [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![s][n] = TRUE]
<1> USE TypeAssumption DEF TypeOKA, SafeCoreA
<1>0. ~Obedient(s)
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. \A src \in Node : newRcv[src][n] => sentMsg[src][n]
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. \A src \in Node : Obedient(src) => ~newRcv[src][n]
  BY <1>0, <1>1
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, NoQuorumsL

LEMMA CoreSendL ==
  ASSUME TypeOKA, SafeCoreA,
         NEW n \in Node, ~Obedient(n),
         sentMsg' \in [Node -> [Node -> BOOLEAN]],
         \A m \in Node : m # n => sentMsg'[m] = sentMsg[m],
         \A d \in Node : sentMsg[n][d] => sentMsg'[n][d],
         rcvMsg' = rcvMsg, accept' = accept
  PROVE  SafeCoreA'
BY TypeAssumption DEF TypeOKA, SafeCoreA

LEMMA CoreRcvL ==
  ASSUME TypeOKA, SafeCoreA,
         NEW n \in Node, NEW s \in Node, sentMsg[s][n],
         rcvMsg' = [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![s][n] = TRUE],
         sentMsg' \in [Node -> [Node -> BOOLEAN]],
         accept' \in [Node -> BOOLEAN],
         \A m \in Node : m # n => sentMsg'[m] = sentMsg[m],
         \A d \in Node : sentMsg[n][d] => sentMsg'[n][d],
         \A m \in Node : m # n => accept'[m] = accept[m],
         Obedient(n) => (sentMsg' = sentMsg /\ accept' = accept)
  PROVE  SafeCoreA'
<1> USE TypeAssumption DEF TypeOKA, SafeCoreA
<1>1. CASE Obedient(n)
  <2>1. \A src \in Node : rcvMsg'[src][n] => sentMsg[src][n]
    BY <1>1, ObedNoQL
  <2>2. QED
    BY <1>1, <2>1
<1>2. CASE ~Obedient(n)
  BY <1>2
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA CoreNextL ==
  ASSUME TypeOKA, NoObInitA, SafeCoreA, Next
  PROVE  SafeCoreA'
<1> USE TypeAssumption DEF TypeOKA
<1>1. CASE \E n \in Node : ReceiveInit(n)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node : ReceiveInit(n)
    BY <1>1
  <2>2. ~Obedient(n)
    BY <2>1 DEF NoObInitA, ReceiveInit
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, CoreSendL DEF ReceiveInit, SendAllFrom
<1>2. CASE \E n \in Node : FaultySendS(n)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node : FaultySendS(n)
    BY <1>2
  <2>2. ~Obedient(n)
    BY <2>1 DEF Obedient, FaultySendS
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, CoreSendL DEF FaultySendS, SendAllFrom
<1>3. CASE \E n \in Node : ReceiveInitI(n)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node : ReceiveInitI(n)
    BY <1>3
  <2>2. ~Obedient(n)
    BY <2>1 DEF NoObInitA, ReceiveInitI
  <2>3. PICK newRow \in [Node -> BOOLEAN] :
          /\ \A dst \in Node : sentMsg[n][dst] => newRow[dst]
          /\ sentMsg' = [sentMsg EXCEPT ![n] = newRow]
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveInitI
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, CoreSendL DEF ReceiveInitI
<1>4. CASE \E n \in Node : FaultySendA(n)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node : FaultySendA(n)
    BY <1>4
  <2>2. ~Obedient(n)
    BY <2>1 DEF Obedient, FaultySendA
  <2>3. PICK newRow \in [Node -> BOOLEAN] :
          /\ \A dst \in Node : sentMsg[n][dst] => newRow[dst]
          /\ sentMsg' = [sentMsg EXCEPT ![n] = newRow]
    BY <2>1 DEF FaultySendA
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, CoreSendL DEF FaultySendA
<1>5. CASE \E n \in Node : FaultyStateSA(n)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node : FaultyStateSA(n)
    BY <1>5
  <2>2. ~Obedient(n)
    BY <2>1 DEF Obedient, FaultyStateSA
  <2>3. PICK newAccept \in BOOLEAN, newCol \in [Node -> BOOLEAN] :
          /\ accept' = [accept EXCEPT ![n] = newAccept]
          /\ rcvMsg' = SetReceiveColumn(rcvMsg, n, newCol)
    BY <2>1 DEF FaultyStateSA
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3 DEF FaultyStateSA, SetReceiveColumn, SafeCoreA
<1>6. CASE \E n, s \in Node : ReceiveMsg(n, s)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node, s \in Node : ReceiveMsg(n, s)
    BY <1>6
  <2>2. sentMsg[s][n]
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveMsg
  <2>3. Obedient(n) => (sentMsg' = sentMsg /\ accept' = accept)
    BY <2>1, <2>2, ObedNoQL DEF ReceiveMsg
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, CoreRcvL DEF ReceiveMsg, SendAllFrom
<1>7. CASE \E n, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgC(n, s)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgC(n, s)
    BY <1>7
  <2>2. sentMsg[s][n]
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveMsgC
  <2>3. PICK send \in BOOLEAN :
          LET newRcv == [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![s][n] = TRUE] IN
            /\ rcvMsg' = newRcv
            /\ accept' = IF HasBQuorumRcv(n, newRcv)
                           THEN [accept EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE] ELSE accept
            /\ sentMsg' = IF HasAQuorumRcv(n, newRcv) /\ send
                            THEN SendAllFrom(sentMsg, n) ELSE sentMsg
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveMsgC
  <2>4. Obedient(n) => (sentMsg' = sentMsg /\ accept' = accept)
    BY <2>2, <2>3, ObedNoQL
  <2>5. QED
    BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, CoreRcvL DEF SendAllFrom
<1>8. CASE \E n, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgI(n, s)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgI(n, s)
    BY <1>8
  <2>2. sentMsg[s][n]
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveMsgI
  <2>3. Obedient(n)
    BY <2>1, QuorumAssumption DEF ReceiveMsgI, Obedient
  <2>4. PICK newRow \in [Node -> BOOLEAN] :
          LET newRcv == [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![s][n] = TRUE] IN
            /\ rcvMsg' = newRcv
            /\ accept' = IF HasBQuorumRcv(n, newRcv)
                           THEN [accept EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE] ELSE accept
            /\ (IF HasAQuorumRcv(n, newRcv)
                  THEN \A dst \in Node : sentMsg[n][dst] => newRow[dst]
                  ELSE newRow = sentMsg[n])
            /\ sentMsg' = [sentMsg EXCEPT ![n] = newRow]
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveMsgI
  <2>5. sentMsg' = sentMsg /\ accept' = accept
    <3>1. ~HasAQuorumRcv(n, [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![s][n] = TRUE])
          /\ ~HasBQuorumRcv(n, [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![s][n] = TRUE])
      BY <2>2, <2>3, ObedNoQL
    <3>2. newRow = sentMsg[n]
      BY <2>4, <3>1
    <3>3. sentMsg' = sentMsg
      BY <2>4, <3>2
    <3>4. QED
      BY <2>4, <3>1, <3>3
  <2>6. QED
    BY <2>2, <2>4, <2>5, CoreRcvL
<1>9. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8 DEF Next


\* ------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Safety theorem
\* ------------------------------------------------------------------

LEMMA SafeInitL == Init => SafeInvA
  BY TypeAssumption DEF Init, SafeInvA, SafeCoreA, TypeOKA

LEMMA SafeNextL == ASSUME SafeInvA, [Next]_vars PROVE SafeInvA'
<1>1. TypeOKA'
  BY TypeNextL DEF SafeInvA
<1>2. NoObInitA' => SafeCoreA'
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NoObInitA' PROVE SafeCoreA'
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. NoObInitA
    BY DEF NoObInitA, Obedient
  <2>2. SafeCoreA /\ TypeOKA
    BY <2>1 DEF SafeInvA
  <2>3. CASE UNCHANGED vars
    BY <2>2, <2>3 DEF SafeCoreA, vars
  <2>4. CASE Next
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>4, CoreNextL
  <2>5. QED
    BY <2>3, <2>4 DEF vars
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF SafeInvA

LEMMA SafeImpL == SafeInvA => Unforgeability
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME SafeInvA, \E n \in Node : Obedient(n) /\ accept[n]
             PROVE  \E m \in Node : Obedient(m) /\ m \in RcvInit
  BY DEF Unforgeability
<1>1. ~NoObInitA
  BY DEF SafeInvA, SafeCoreA
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1 DEF NoObInitA

\* ------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Liveness invariant
\* ------------------------------------------------------------------

LiveCoreA ==
  /\ \A s, d \in Node : (Obedient(d) /\ rcvMsg[s][d]) => sentMsg[s][d]
  /\ \A z \in Node : Symmetric(z) =>
        (\A d1, d2 \in Node : sentMsg[z][d1] => sentMsg[z][d2])
  /\ \A n \in Node : (Obedient(n) /\ accept[n]) => HasBQuorumRcv(n, rcvMsg)

LiveInvA == TypeOKA /\ LiveCoreA

LEMMA HasBMonoL ==
  ASSUME NEW n, NEW rm1, NEW rm2, HasBQuorumRcv(n, rm1),
         \A src \in Node : rm1[src][n] => rm2[src][n]
  PROVE  HasBQuorumRcv(n, rm2)
  BY DEF HasBQuorumRcv

LEMMA HasAMonoL ==
  ASSUME NEW n, NEW rm1, NEW rm2, HasAQuorumRcv(n, rm1),
         \A src \in Node : rm1[src][n] => rm2[src][n]
  PROVE  HasAQuorumRcv(n, rm2)
  BY DEF HasAQuorumRcv

LEMMA LiveSendL ==
  ASSUME TypeOKA, LiveCoreA, NEW n \in Node,
         sentMsg' \in [Node -> [Node -> BOOLEAN]],
         \A m \in Node : m # n => sentMsg'[m] = sentMsg[m],
         \A d \in Node : sentMsg[n][d] => sentMsg'[n][d],
         Symmetric(n) => (\A d1, d2 \in Node : sentMsg'[n][d1] => sentMsg'[n][d2]),
         rcvMsg' = rcvMsg, accept' = accept
  PROVE  LiveCoreA'
BY TypeAssumption DEF TypeOKA, LiveCoreA

LEMMA LiveRcvL ==
  ASSUME TypeOKA, LiveCoreA,
         NEW n \in Node, NEW s \in Node, sentMsg[s][n],
         rcvMsg' = [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![s][n] = TRUE],
         sentMsg' \in [Node -> [Node -> BOOLEAN]],
         accept' \in [Node -> BOOLEAN],
         \A m \in Node : m # n => sentMsg'[m] = sentMsg[m],
         \A d \in Node : sentMsg[n][d] => sentMsg'[n][d],
         Symmetric(n) => (\A d1, d2 \in Node : sentMsg'[n][d1] => sentMsg'[n][d2]),
         \A m \in Node : m # n => accept'[m] = accept[m],
         accept'[n] => (accept[n] \/ HasBQuorumRcv(n, rcvMsg'))
  PROVE  LiveCoreA'
<1> USE TypeAssumption DEF TypeOKA
<1>0. \A m \in Node : \A src \in Node : rcvMsg[src][m] => rcvMsg'[src][m]
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. \A s1, d \in Node : (Obedient(d) /\ rcvMsg'[s1][d]) => sentMsg'[s1][d]
  BY DEF LiveCoreA
<1>2. \A z \in Node : Symmetric(z) =>
        (\A d1, d2 \in Node : sentMsg'[z][d1] => sentMsg'[z][d2])
  BY DEF LiveCoreA
<1>3. \A m \in Node : (Obedient(m) /\ accept'[m]) => HasBQuorumRcv(m, rcvMsg')
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW m \in Node, Obedient(m), accept'[m]
               PROVE  HasBQuorumRcv(m, rcvMsg')
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. CASE m = n
    <3>1. CASE accept[n]
      BY <1>0, <2>1, <3>1, HasBMonoL DEF LiveCoreA
    <3>2. QED
      BY <2>1, <3>1
  <2>2. CASE m # n
    BY <1>0, <2>2, HasBMonoL DEF LiveCoreA
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF LiveCoreA

LEMMA LiveNextL ==
  ASSUME TypeOKA, LiveCoreA, Next
  PROVE  LiveCoreA'
<1> USE TypeAssumption DEF TypeOKA
<1>1. CASE \E n \in Node : ReceiveInit(n)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node : ReceiveInit(n)
    BY <1>1
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, LiveSendL DEF ReceiveInit, SendAllFrom
<1>2. CASE \E n \in Node : FaultySendS(n)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node : FaultySendS(n)
    BY <1>2
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, LiveSendL DEF FaultySendS, SendAllFrom
<1>3. CASE \E n \in Node : ReceiveInitI(n)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node : ReceiveInitI(n)
    BY <1>3
  <2>2. ~Symmetric(n)
    BY <2>1, QuorumAssumption DEF Symmetric, ReceiveInitI
  <2>3. PICK newRow \in [Node -> BOOLEAN] :
          /\ \A dst \in Node : sentMsg[n][dst] => newRow[dst]
          /\ sentMsg' = [sentMsg EXCEPT ![n] = newRow]
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveInitI
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, LiveSendL DEF ReceiveInitI
<1>4. CASE \E n \in Node : FaultySendA(n)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node : FaultySendA(n)
    BY <1>4
  <2>2. ~Symmetric(n)
    BY <2>1 DEF Symmetric, FaultySendA
  <2>3. PICK newRow \in [Node -> BOOLEAN] :
          /\ \A dst \in Node : sentMsg[n][dst] => newRow[dst]
          /\ sentMsg' = [sentMsg EXCEPT ![n] = newRow]
    BY <2>1 DEF FaultySendA
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, LiveSendL DEF FaultySendA
<1>5. CASE \E n \in Node : FaultyStateSA(n)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node : FaultyStateSA(n)
    BY <1>5
  <2>2. ~Obedient(n)
    BY <2>1 DEF Obedient, FaultyStateSA
  <2>3. PICK newAccept \in BOOLEAN, newCol \in [Node -> BOOLEAN] :
          /\ accept' = [accept EXCEPT ![n] = newAccept]
          /\ rcvMsg' = SetReceiveColumn(rcvMsg, n, newCol)
    BY <2>1 DEF FaultyStateSA
  <2>4. sentMsg' = sentMsg
    BY <2>1 DEF FaultyStateSA
  <2>5. \A m \in Node : m # n =>
          (\A src \in Node : rcvMsg[src][m] => rcvMsg'[src][m])
    BY <2>3 DEF SetReceiveColumn
  <2>6. QED
    BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, HasBMonoL DEF SetReceiveColumn, LiveCoreA
<1>6. CASE \E n, s \in Node : ReceiveMsg(n, s)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node, s \in Node : ReceiveMsg(n, s)
    BY <1>6
  <2>2. sentMsg[s][n]
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveMsg
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, LiveRcvL DEF ReceiveMsg, SendAllFrom, LiveCoreA
<1>7. CASE \E n, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgC(n, s)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgC(n, s)
    BY <1>7
  <2>2. sentMsg[s][n]
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveMsgC
  <2>3. PICK send \in BOOLEAN :
          LET newRcv == [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![s][n] = TRUE] IN
            /\ rcvMsg' = newRcv
            /\ accept' = IF HasBQuorumRcv(n, newRcv)
                           THEN [accept EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE] ELSE accept
            /\ sentMsg' = IF HasAQuorumRcv(n, newRcv) /\ send
                            THEN SendAllFrom(sentMsg, n) ELSE sentMsg
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveMsgC
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>2, <2>3, LiveRcvL DEF SendAllFrom, LiveCoreA
<1>8. CASE \E n, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgI(n, s)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgI(n, s)
    BY <1>8
  <2>2. sentMsg[s][n]
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveMsgI
  <2>3. ~Symmetric(n)
    BY <2>1, QuorumAssumption DEF Symmetric, ReceiveMsgI
  <2>4. PICK newRow \in [Node -> BOOLEAN] :
          LET newRcv == [rcvMsg EXCEPT ![s][n] = TRUE] IN
            /\ rcvMsg' = newRcv
            /\ accept' = IF HasBQuorumRcv(n, newRcv)
                           THEN [accept EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE] ELSE accept
            /\ (IF HasAQuorumRcv(n, newRcv)
                  THEN \A dst \in Node : sentMsg[n][dst] => newRow[dst]
                  ELSE newRow = sentMsg[n])
            /\ sentMsg' = [sentMsg EXCEPT ![n] = newRow]
    BY <2>1 DEF ReceiveMsgI
  <2>5. \A d \in Node : sentMsg[n][d] => sentMsg'[n][d]
    BY <2>4
  <2>6. QED
    BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, LiveRcvL
<1>9. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8 DEF Next

LEMMA LiveInvInitL == Init => LiveInvA
  BY TypeAssumption DEF Init, LiveInvA, LiveCoreA, TypeOKA

LEMMA LiveInvNextL == ASSUME LiveInvA, [Next]_vars PROVE LiveInvA'
<1>1. TypeOKA'
  BY TypeNextL DEF LiveInvA
<1>2. LiveCoreA'
  <2>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
    BY <2>1 DEF LiveInvA, LiveCoreA, vars
  <2>2. CASE Next
    BY <2>2, LiveNextL DEF LiveInvA
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2 DEF vars
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF LiveInvA

LEMMA LiveInvL == SafetySpec => []LiveInvA
<1>1. Init => LiveInvA
  BY LiveInvInitL
<1>2. LiveInvA /\ [Next]_vars => LiveInvA'
  BY LiveInvNextL
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, PTL DEF SafetySpec


\* ------------------------------------------------------------------
\* Monotonicity
\* ------------------------------------------------------------------

LEMMA SentMonoL ==
  ASSUME TypeOKA, [Next]_vars
  PROVE  \A m, d \in Node : sentMsg[m][d] => sentMsg'[m][d]
<1> USE TypeAssumption DEF TypeOKA
<1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
  BY <1>1 DEF vars
<1>2. CASE \E n \in Node : ReceiveInit(n)
  BY <1>2 DEF ReceiveInit, SendAllFrom
<1>3. CASE \E n, s \in Node : ReceiveMsg(n, s)
  BY <1>3 DEF ReceiveMsg, SendAllFrom
<1>4. CASE \E n, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgC(n, s)
  <2>1. PICK n \in Node, s \in Node : ReceiveMsgC(n, s)
    BY <1>4
  <2>2. PICK send \in BOOLEAN :
